summary: Provides setup code for debugging a PowerShell module locally: set ErrorActionPreference to Stop, provide args via args.json or $complex_args, load C# utils with Add-CSharpType and PowerShell utils with Import-Module; debug in PowerShell ISE or VS Code.
questions: How do I pass arguments to a PowerShell module when debugging it outside Ansible?
How do I load the C# utils when running a Windows module by hand?
Which IDEs can I use to debug PowerShell modules?

answer_card.title: Debug setup code for Windows modules
answer_card.answer_md:
```powershell
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
$args = @("$($pwd.Path)\args.json")
# or
$complex_args = @{ _ansible_check_mode = $false; _ansible_diff = $false; path = "C:\temp"; state = "present" }
Import-Module -Name "$($pwd.Path)\powershell\Ansible.ModuleUtils.AddType.psm1"
$_csharp_utils = @([System.IO.File]::ReadAllText("$($pwd.Path)\csharp\Ansible.Basic.cs"))
Add-CSharpType -References $_csharp_utils -IncludeDebugInfo
Import-Module -Name "$($pwd.Path)\powershell\Ansible.ModuleUtils.Legacy.psm1"
```
`args.json` uses `{"ANSIBLE_MODULE_ARGS": {...}}`. Debug in PowerShell ISE or VS Code.
